verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: On the first day of the new month, in one of those days in the month, you shall build your dwelling place, your tent for the Lord.
verses.3: And you set up there the symbol of judgment, and you covered that symbol with a covering.
verses.4: And you brought out the scale, and you measured its weight. Then you brought out the candle, and you lit its wicks.
verses.5: And you set the golden altar in front of the Ark of the Covenant. You also placed the door of the temple there.
verses.6: And you shall place the altar of the Lord in front of the entrance to the temple.
verses.7: And you shall place the altar between the tabernacle and the altar itself. And there, you shall pour out water.
verses.8: And you set up the walls around it, and you also placed the gateposts in front of the gate.
verses.9: And you took the wine that was used for immersion, and you sanctified it along with the altar and everything that was inside it. It became holy.
verses.10: And you shall destroy the altar and all its utensils. You shall make the altar holy, and it will become a holy place.
verses.11: And you sanctified the altar and its utensils.
verses.12: And you brought Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tabernacle, and you washed them with water.
verses.13: And you shall cover Aaron with the garments of holiness. You shall anoint him and make him holy. And you shall be his priest.
verses.14: And she will bring her children forward and burn them as offerings.
verses.15: And you shall destroy them just as you destroyed their ancestors. You will make them your servants, and they will become your slaves forever.
verses.16: And Moses did all that Jehovah commanded him. He did just as Jehovah told him.
verses.17: And in the first month of the second year, on one of those months, the tabernacle was established.
verses.18: And Moses built the tabernacle. He set up its poles, arranged its frames, and put its ropes in place. Then he completed its construction.
verses.19: And he broke open the tent over the bedroom. Then he placed the cover of the tent on top of it, just as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.20: And he took the tent and placed it in the sky. He set up the poles on the roof of the tent, and he placed the covering over the roof from above.
verses.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle. He set up the cover over it, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.22: And he placed the altar in the meeting house, on the path leading from the entrance to the temple.
verses.23: And he made it into a altar, as God commanded Moses.
verses.24: And he placed the lampstand in the sanctuary where the meetings took place, along the edge of the tent.
verses.25: And the priests stood before Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.26: And he placed the golden altar in the sanctuary before the Ark of the Covenant.
verses.27: And he was covered with a covering of ashes, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.28: And he set up the doorpost for the entrance to the house.
verses.29: And the altar of the offering was set up outside the sanctuary. They offered their sacrifices and offerings as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.30: And he placed the altar between the sanctuary and the altar of incense. He also gave water for washing.
verses.31: And Moses, Aaron, and their sons washed their hands and feet.
verses.32: When they entered the tabernacle, and as they approached the altar, they sprinkled blood, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.33: And he built the courtyard around the tent and the altar. He also gave the door for the courtyard. Then Moses completed the work.
verses.34: And the cloud covered the tabernacle of God, and the glory of Jehovah filled the temple.
verses.35: And Moses could not enter the Tabernacle, because the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.36: And when the clouds rose above the tent, the children of Israel went forth on all their journeys.
verses.37: And if the cloud does not rise, and if it does not travel towards that day when it will rise.
verses.38: For the sky of Jehovah will be dark over the tent during the day, and fire will be there at night, for the eyes of all the houses of Israel to see.
